import React from 'react'; import PageBanner from '../components/PageBanner'; const ReturnPolicy = () => ( <>

Last updated: Recently

We want you to love your B.unique purchase. If something isn't right, here's how our returns and refunds work.

1. Return Window

You can request a return within the return window specified on our site from the date of receiving your order.

2. Conditions for Return

  • Items must be unused, unworn and in their original packaging with all tags intact.
  • Handmade pieces may show minor variations; these are not considered defects.
  • Customised or personalised items may not be eligible for return unless defective.
  • Sale items may be subject to different return terms.

3. How to Initiate a Return

To initiate a return, please contact our support team with your order number and reason for return. We'll guide you through the process.

4. Refunds

  • Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we'll notify you about the approval of your refund.
  • Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method within a reasonable time.
  • Shipping charges may not be refundable unless the item was received damaged or defective.

5. Damaged or Defective Items

If you receive a damaged or defective item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the item and packaging.

); export default ReturnPolicy;
